subject: Raster image seems to be shifted using leaflet for R (from SO)

messages.author: 9349b31ec7c243b2
messages.subject: Raster image seems to be shifted using leaflet for R (from SO)
parts:
Hello -

I'm seeing the same problem that has been reported about a year ago. 
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/33742107/raster-image-seems-to-be-shifted-using-leaflet-for-r?rq=1

Has anybody found a workaround?

Thanks,
D.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Raster image seems to be shifted using leaflet for R (from SO)
parts: I posted a workaround to that question. If you upsample the raster before giving it to Leaflet it makes the problem go away. Yuck, but, it works...
